Editor · Language educator · Builder

Hi, I’m Yuji.

I’m Yuji Shimizu, the person behind YUJI @ Japan. I introduce Japan in English—not as a museum behind glass, but as a place you can walk through, listen to and keep discovering.

I also created DraMap, an iPhone app built around a simple idea: you can learn Japanese while playing. Japan Unfolded and DraMap share a creator, and this page says so openly. The magazine’s editorial choices are independent; app links are clearly identified rather than disguised as third-party recommendations.

Editorial promise

Curiosity without deception.

Headlines may open a question, but the story must answer it accurately. Rankings state their method. Sponsorship and ownership are disclosed. Cultural context comes before clicks.
